tagline.en: EgoWM — an egocentric, action-conditioned world model that predicts first-person video for navigation.
tagline.zh: EgoWM——以第一人称视角、动作条件化的世界模型,为导航预测第一人称视频。

en: EgoWM is an egocentric world model. Given a first-person view and an intended action, it predicts how the scene ahead would look — a way to imagine the consequences of moving before actually moving, which is useful for navigation.

It is built on Stable Video Diffusion (SVD), and the project ships variants for different action spaces, including a 3-degrees-of-freedom and a 25-degrees-of-freedom setup. WorldFoundry registers the EgoWM source route; running real generation additionally needs the EgoWM checkpoint and assets, fetched separately.
In WorldFoundry you use EgoWM for egocentric navigation and action-conditioned video prediction once its assets are staged.
zh: EgoWM 是一个第一人称视角(egocentric)世界模型。给定一段第一人称画面与一个意图动作,它预测前方场景将会呈现的样子——一种在真正移动之前先想象移动后果的方式,这对导航很有用。
它构建在 Stable Video Diffusion(SVD)之上,项目为不同动作空间提供了变体,包括 3 自由度与 25 自由度两种配置。WorldFoundry 已注册 EgoWM 的源码路由;运行真正的生成还需要 EgoWM 的 checkpoint 与资产,需单独获取。
在 WorldFoundry 中,当资产就位后,你可将 EgoWM 用于第一人称导航与动作条件化的视频预测。

whenToUse.en: Choose EgoWM when you need to predict first-person video conditioned on actions — for example imagining navigation outcomes from an egocentric viewpoint.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要基于动作预测第一人称视频时(例如从第一人称视角想象导航结果),选择 EgoWM。

notFor.en: It generates predicted video, not robot control actions, and it can't run until its checkpoint and assets are downloaded and staged.
notFor.zh: 它生成的是预测视频,而非机器人控制动作,在其 checkpoint 与资产下载并准备好之前也无法运行。

zh: 第一人称、动作条件化的世界模型
提供 3 自由度与 25 自由度动作空间变体
面向第一人称导航预测
